changelog: - **The data wizards' Header row and Ignore last N rows take a number when you press Enter or leave the field.** In Data ▸ Import spreadsheet values as Parameters and in a table's Refresh, these two fields took every key at once. Clearing a header row of 2 showed 1 straight away, so typing 3 made it 13, and in the import wizard each key re-read the pasted text: on the way the header row passed through other rows, and the column roles you had set (key, name, number) were reset. Now what you type is applied only when you press Enter or leave the field, and only a whole number is taken; a blank puts the last value back. The roles are reset only when the header row you confirm has a different number of columns, as before.
